info.title: FluentCart API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCart e-commerce platform

get.description:
Retrieve all registered email notification templates with their current configuration. Returns both default and customized notification settings for orders, subscriptions, and scheduler/reminder actions.

**Access policy:** `StoreSensitivePolicy`

data.description: Email notifications keyed by notification name

order_paid_admin.title: Send mail to admin after New Order Paid
order_paid_admin.description: This email will be sent to the admin after an order is placed.
order_paid_admin.pre_header: You got a new order on your shop! Order #{{order.invoice_no}} totaling {{order.total_amount_formatted}}.
order_paid_admin.name: order_paid_admin

order_paid_customer.title: Purchase receipt to customer
order_paid_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer after an order is placed.
order_paid_customer.name: order_paid_customer

order_refunded_admin.title: Order refund notification to admin
order_refunded_admin.description: This email will be sent to the admin when an order is refunded.
order_refunded_admin.pre_header: A refund has been processed for order #{{order.invoice_no}}.
order_refunded_admin.name: order_refunded_admin

order_refunded_customer.title: Order refund notification to customer
order_refunded_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer when their order is refunded.
order_refunded_customer.name: order_refunded_customer

subscription_renewal_customer.title: Subscription renewal notification to customer
subscription_renewal_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer when their subscription is renewed.
subscription_renewal_customer.name: subscription_renewal_customer

subscription_canceled_customer.title: Subscription canceled notification to customer
subscription_canceled_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer when their subscription is canceled.
subscription_canceled_customer.name: subscription_canceled_customer

order_delivered_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer after an order is marked as delivered
order_delivered_customer.name: order_delivered_customer

order_placed_admin.title: Send mail to admin after New Order Placed (Offline Payment)
order_placed_admin.description: This email will be sent to the admin when an order is placed using offline payment method.
order_placed_admin.pre_header: You have a new order on your shop placed with offline payment. Please review the order details in this email. You can also go to FluentCart Dashboard to view the order details and manage it. Thank you for using FluentCart.

order_placed_customer.title: Order confirmation to customer (Offline Payment)
order_placed_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer when an order is placed using offline payment method.

order_shipped_customer.title: Send mail to customer when shipping status changed to shipped.
order_shipped_customer.description: This email will be sent to the customer after an order is marked as shipped

renewal_created_admin.title: Notify admin when a renewal order is created

renewal_created_customer.title: Send the renewal order to the customer when a renewal order is created

renewal_reminder_due_admin.title: Renewal due reminder copy to admin

subscription_canceled_admin.title: Send mail to admin when a subscription is canceled

template_path.description: Dot-notation path to the default PHP email template

is_async.description: Whether the email is sent asynchronously

manage_toggle.description: Present only on notifications with a special enable/disable behavior (e.g. auto-enabled for offline payments, or on-demand only). Indicates whether the toggle is user-manageable.

toggle_label.description: Human-readable label describing the toggle behavior when manage_toggle is present.

is_default_body.description: Whether to use the built-in PHP template

email_body.description: Custom email body content (HTML). Empty when using default body

attach_pdf_template.description: PDF template slug to attach to this email, when the notification supports PDF receipt attachments (order-related notifications only). Empty string when not applicable or not configured.

ApplicationPasswords.name: Authorization
ApplicationPasswords.description: WordPress Application Passwords — use Basic auth with your WordPress username and an application password in the format: username:application_password
